name: ByTheLaw
operator: ByTheLaw (the vendor); each customer is the operator of its own use
basis: ByTheLaw's own public pages (product, documentation, blog, customer stories, legal and security pages)
what: Chat assistant that answers legal questions with citations to official Portuguese and EU sources, analyses uploaded documents, drafts contracts, emails and translations, and organises work in projects. The site menu names it 'ByTheLaw: Legal research and knowledge'; the help centre calls it 'Legal Chat'.
note: A scan of a product as its vendor documents it, not of any one deployment. Made by the report studio: a researcher-assessor, a challenger, then the scorer. Part of the first Portuguese cohort.
grant_note: Not measured. No deployment shape for this product is published in the capability grammar.

I01.n: ByTheLaw supplies its own assistant, which lawyers use as provided through a subscription.
I01.span: ByTheLaw is an AI platform built for lawyers and legal teams

I07.n: It answers legal questions from official sources with citations, which the lawyer checks before using.
I07.span: Ask legal questions in plain language and get answers grounded in official sources

I09.n: It works on legal material: Portuguese and European legislation, case law and the user's uploaded documents.
I09.span: Specialized in Portuguese and European legal context.

I11.n: The Citius integration uses the lawyer's own Citius credentials to read the courts system automatically, and Citius can be a source of the chat on request and approval; experimental, granted by ByTheLaw to selected users.
I11.span: utilizar as Credenciais Citius para aceder ao Citius de forma automatizada

I15.n: The lawyer writes each request and the assistant returns an answer to it.
I15.span: ByTheLaw interprets the request and returns an answer grounded in official sources.

I20.n: The help centre lists what the assistant is for: legal questions, document analysis, drafting, reading legislation, organising work.
I20.span: Analyse contracts, articles of association and case files you upload to a chat

I21.n: The Citius terms limit the integration to reading and consulting, and state it performs no procedural acts.
I21.span: não pratica, nem pratica em nome do Utilizador, quaisquer atos processuais

I22.n: Help pages document limits of use, such as upload limits and that files attached inside an email are not opened.
I22.span: Files attached inside the email are not opened

I36.n: The GDPR is named as the law under which personal data in the platform is processed.
I36.span: Personal data is processed in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation.

I38.n: In the Citius integration, an unread notification is opened (which marks it read in Citius, irreversibly) only after the user's prior express action, preceded by a warning.
I38.span: após ação prévia e expressa do Utilizador na Plataforma

I39.n: A stop button lets the user interrupt an answer while it is being generated, on all plans.
I39.span: Pode interromper a resposta do chatbot a qualquer momento.

I46.n: A user can restrict, per project, which sources answers draw on; it is a setting the user's own account changes.
I46.span: lets you choose which sources that project may consult

I47.n: The Citius terms state in prose that the authorisation covers only consulting and reading.
I47.span: A autorização prevista no número anterior é limitada às operações de

I54.n: The Citius terms commit to notifying the user without undue delay of a security breach affecting credentials or data.
I54.span: notificará o Utilizador, sem demora injustificada, de qualquer violação de segurança

I57.n: A report-error button is available from the help icon and on failed messages; answers also carry like and dislike feedback.
I57.span: O botão de reportar erro passa a estar disponível como popup flutuante

I58.n: The help centre lists the legislative, case-law and regulatory databases answers are drawn from.
I58.span: ByTheLaw draws on the legislative, case-law and regulatory databases in this list

S3.n: The site publishes an llms.txt describing the product and its pages; fetched and resolving on 10 November 2026.
S3.span: The product itself (sign-up and the web app) lives on a separate domain

announced.what: International expansion beyond Portugal is planned.
A paid NPL pilot with an Iberian servicer is being prepared.
Marketing calls the product 'fully autonomous' and a 'service-as-a-software'; not counted.
Product page claims up to 20 hours a week saved; ECO reports a claim of about 63 hours per user per year; not counted.
